entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • `CS7003` is only reported during build and doesn't appear on the IDE #80419
  • CA1508 is triggered despite value being set #80414

Closed

  • SyntaxGenerator creates type syntax as QualifiedName but parsing the same syntax results in SimpleMemberAccessExpression #80427
  • Static extension methods do not hide static methods from base classes #80416
  • MSB3883 on *nix when using Microsoft.Net.Compilers package #39530
    18.0 P2
  • Negative span start in `SyntaxTreeDiagnosticEnumerator` #79935
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • Test behavior of GetSymbolToLocationMap in presence of extension blocks #80434
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix check for extension params parameter in nullable analysis #80433
    Area-Compilers
  • [release/dev18.0] Update NgenPriority of couple assemblies in compiler tools #80430
  • Remove unnecessary branch info from PublishData.json #80428
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Make method non-generic #80425
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Ensure custom attributes bag of a parameter backing field is properly initialized during "completion" of a primary constructor. #80424
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Primary Constructors
  • Extensions: AssociatedExtensionImplementation on constructed symbols #80423
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Fix issue when caching CompilationWithAnalyzers against ProjectState instead of a project #80422
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Extensions: throw NotSupportedException instead of null #80420
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Fix syntax map for unmodified partial constructor #80417
    Area-Interactive, VSCode

Merged

  • [release/dev18.0] Update localization branch to dev18.0 #80436
  • Update localization branch to dev18.0 #80435
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Remove github comment on dartlab pipeline #80431
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Use a single H1 for the document title #80432
    Area-Compilers, Community, Next
  • Main: Revert "Use immutable types in signature help (#80322)" #80421
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Dev18: Revert "Use immutable types in signature help (#80322)" #80426
    VSCode
  • Fix index out of bounds producing diagnostic in error recovery scenario #80391
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Switch diagnostic computation into a normal yield-based enumerator #80384
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Snap for 18.0 P2 #80415
    Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode

Updated

  • Allow dotnet-watch to use MSBuildProjectLoader without launching out-of-process build hosts #80359
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Update NgenPriority of couple assemblies in compiler tools #80411
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Add copilot-setup-steps.yml #80412
  • Avoid narrowing types in `or` patterns #80348
    Area-Compilers
  • Allow `ToArray` optimization when resulting array can be implicitly reference-converted to the target array #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Move package publishing out of Roslyn official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80376
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Make syntax diagnostic offsets relative to the *Start* of a node/token instead of relative to the *FullStart* #80393
    Area-Compilers
  • Followup offset work. #80394
    Area-Compilers
  • Add analyzer to remove unnecessary nullable suppressions (`!`). #80404
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Initial spike for file-based programs editor features DLL #80410
    Area-IDE, VSCode
